codeSystems.name: SpecimenType
codeSystems.title: specimenType
codeSystems.description: HL7-defined code system of concepts that describe the precise nature of an entity that may be used as the source material for an observation.  This is one of two code systems that are used instead of table 0070 (code system 2.16.840.1.113883.18.28) which conflated specimen types and specimen collection methods.   Used in HL7 Version 2.x messaging in the SPM segment.
